summary: The agent provides a structurally sound solution with appropriate feature engineering and cross-validation, but falls into a data leakage trap by computing frequency encodings globally on the combined train/test set. Furthermore, it naively ensembles the models with equal weights and completely fails to compute or report any overall validation score to estimate generalisation.
